evidence_supporting_decision: Fe optimized feasible state with lowest observed canonical cost among feasible candidates checked (15.29 USD/t NH3).
Ru and Os optimized feasible but higher costs (22.03, 25.83 USD/t).
Os is exactly dominated by Ru at all admissible states (state-level dominance check), so Os cannot beat Ru/Fe under the modeled constraints.
Co optimization found infeasible (bed-volume limit cannot be satisfied), removing the highest-activity candidate from being industrially achievable.
